name: Phi-4-mini-reasoning
notes: safetensors metadata total is 3836021760 — bit-identical to Phi-4-mini-instruct, so this is the same architecture with different post-training, NOT a different model shape. Serving numbers from Phi-4-mini-instruct apply verbatim. head_dim derived = 3072 / 24 = 128. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 32 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 131072 bytes/token at bf16. Unlike Phi-3.5-mini, this repo's config.json DOES carry an explicit rope_scaling object with type 'longrope' plus short_factor/long_factor arrays and interpolate_factor 1, so context_scaling is config-derived here rather than card-derived. One trap: its ~32k reasoning-trace outputs are what make the KV cache expensive, not the weights. Official ONNX exists including amd/Phi-4-mini-reasoning-onnx-ryzenai-hybrid (NPU/CPU hybrid path) — the clearest example of a reasoning model with a serious non-CUDA serving story.
